confirmed: Isp STOP, Pac STEADY, bridge crossing, and Isp RESCUE form the main relay anticipated in pass one.

missed_mechanics: The final requirement is simultaneous hero-specific TARGET pads, which are co-located with exits.
The recurring Gem bubble offers optional FLOAT crossing/recovery and is interrupted by STEADY/RESCUE; the sugar pump is display feedback.
incorrect_inferences: Pass one proposed interacting with the SUGAR PUMP I/P symbols. Source shows the pump artwork reflects boss state; TARGET pad occupancy drives shutdown.
changed_judgments: Recovery null to 3 because lethal gaps/core reset a multi-step relay; the current source also shows safe staging for nonlethal retries.
Control friction null to 0 for verified scripted response only.
unresolved: No human data show whether players understand the pump/target relationship or choose the optional FLOAT route.

single_operator_note: A single operator may need to hold Pac on STEADY while steering Isp through moving and FLOAT segments; the two-human baseline keeps those inputs separate.
